title: fix(console): the Flow Runs picker reads a flattened flow item's label (objectui#12783)
body:
Fixes #12783
Clause-②: no

The developer Flow Runs page's flow picker lists every flow by its API name against a real server. objectstack's `getMetaItems` answers `meta.getItems('flow')` with flattened items: each flow's `name` and `label` sit on the item itself, with no `spec` member. The page's item normalization in `loadFlows` (`FlowRunsPage.tsx`) read the name as `it?.spec?.name ?? it?.name` but the label as `it?.spec?.label` alone, so the label was always `undefined` and the option fell back to the bare name.

The label is now read the way the name is, `spec` first and then the item itself:

```ts
name: it?.spec?.name ?? it?.name,
label: it?.spec?.label ?? it?.label,
```

The picker therefore shows the page's own `label (name)` form for a labelled flow, and a flow with no label still shows its bare name. Nothing else on the page changes: no export, prop, type member or i18n key.

## Reproduction, before and after (browser)

Backend: objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port, used as a backend only. Console: this worktree's `apps/console` Vite dev server pointed at it. The probe signs in, opens `/apps/showcase_app/component/developer/flow-runs`, records the raw `GET /api/v1/meta/flow` answer the page receives, and reads every option of the picker.

The raw answer the page receives (identical in both runs): envelope keys `type`, `items`, `registrations`; 32 items; **0** items carry a `spec` member; **32** carry a top-level `label`. `showcase_batch_reminders` is served as `name: showcase_batch_reminders`, `label: Batch Task Reminders (Loop)`, no `spec`.

| Reading | unchanged `main` `33ee9de` | this branch `d841908` |
|---|---|---|
| options listed | 32 | 32 |
| options in `label (name)` form | **0** | **32** |
| `showcase_batch_reminders` option text | `showcase_batch_reminders` | `Batch Task Reminders (Loop) (showcase_batch_reminders)` |
| trigger on load | `showcase_task_completed` | `Notify on Task Completed (showcase_task_completed)` |

On the branch, picking that flow shows the trigger `Batch Task Reminders (Loop) (showcase_batch_reminders)`, and the Test Run panel lists its input variable `tasks` with type `list`: the runner reads the flow body from `spec: it?.spec ?? it`, which already fell back to the flat item.

## Pins

New file `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.flattenedLabel-12783.test.tsx`, three cases, each reading the opened picker's option texts:

1. a flattened answer shaped as the served list (`{ type, items }`, item flat, no `spec`): `Batch Task Reminders (Loop) (showcase_batch_reminders)`, then `nightly_sync`;
2. a `spec`-wrapped answer: the same two texts;
3. an unlabelled flat flow: `nightly_sync` alone.

Direction, measured on unchanged `main` (fix absent, pins present): `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. Case 1 is red with `- "Batch Task Reminders (Loop) (showcase_batch_reminders)"` / `+ "showcase_batch_reminders"`. Cases 2 and 3 are green there by design: they guard the forms the fix must not disturb. With the fix: `Tests 3 passed (3)`.

## Ablations (one per pin, fix committed first)

Each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: the literal anchor `label: it?.spec?.label ?? it?.label,` hit once, the mutation was verified on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed), the pin file ran, and the file was restored from `HEAD`. Restore was proven per leg by the blob hash equal to the `HEAD` blob (`5147dc4b438b`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject is imported from source (`./FlowRunsPage`), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | drop the flat arm: `label: it?.spec?.label,` | case 1 red, 2 and 3 green (`1 failed, 2 passed`) |
| A2 | drop the `spec` arm: `label: it?.label,` | case 2 red, 1 and 3 green (`1 failed, 2 passed`) |
| A3 | let the name stand in for a missing label: `... ?? it?.spec?.name ?? it?.name,` | all three red (`3 failed`): every case lists the unlabelled `nightly_sync`, received as `nightly_sync (nightly_sync)` |

## Hypothesis 1: other reads on this page that assume `spec`

None that changes what a user sees. The page reads no flow description and no flow type. The only other `spec` read is `spec: it?.spec ?? it`, which already falls back to the flat item; the Test Run panel's input variables come from it and are live on the served list (the `tasks` reading above). Nothing outside the claimed lines was changed.

## Local gates (final commit `d841908`)

- closure build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` through the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/developer/` (repo-root form, every suite under the directory, the new file included): `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 139 passed (139)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (script name echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`): exit 0. `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` in `apps/console` lists all 17 test files under the directory, the new one included.
- eslint on the two changed source files with the repo config and `--no-inline-config`: exit 0, 0 errors; every warning sits on a line this diff does not touch.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, one changeset declared (`@object-ui/console` patch).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `0 new citation(s)`.
- also run: `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, both exit 0.

The rest of the farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `spec` arm has no measured producer.** On the showcase server 0 of 32 listed items carry `spec`, and the spec's `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema` types `items` as unknown. The page's other suites (`FlowRunsPage.test.tsx`, `FlowRunsPage.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, `developerMetadataEnvelope.contractEnvelope-6917.test.tsx`) feed only `spec`-wrapped items, which is why none of them saw this. This change keeps the `spec` arm for the label exactly as the name already had it, as the claim pinned; whether both arms should be retired in favour of the flat item alone is a separate question, raised in the dev report.
- **Long labels truncate in the trigger.** With labels shown, the longest showcase option, `Nested Fan-out Reminders (Loop of Parallel) (showcase_nested_fan_out_reminders)`, is clipped in the closed trigger to `Nested Fan-out Reminders (Loop of Parallel)...`, and the clipped line is centred. That comes from the shared Shadcn `SelectTrigger` (its `line-clamp-1` on the value span inside a button). The open list shows every option in full. Not filed: it is the primitive's generic behaviour, not this page's.
- `FlowItem.updatedAt` is normalized from `updatedAt` or `updated_at` but is never rendered. Left as is.

The work was done in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`.
